statements.markdown: **Lemma 8.8 (Mod-12 filter, $J\ge7$).** *For $J\ge7$, the inequality $\mu_J(M)\le11/15$ implies $12\mid M$. Thus only multiples of $12$ need be tested as witnesses in each interval $[n,2n-2]$; no potentially uncovered rank is discarded.*
